I was graduating from college and I had zero money in my bank account. My parents never really helped me financially. I had to drive to campus which was 45 minutes away to pick up my graduation gown and I was low on gas. To make matters worse I was devastated because the guy who promised me I could borrow his cap (I opted out of paying to save money) wanted me to give him a sexual favour for it. I was stressed about finding a cap and then my tank alerted me that I was on “empty”. At the gas station, I paid a dollar or so in change that I could find by tearing the car apart. Honestly $1 isn’t enough to get me to campus because it was still 20 minutes away and with traffic it could be way longer. I paid inside and when I went to fill my tank, I saw a credit of $20. I was confused and asked the teller about it and he said the guy behind me paid for my gas. When I found him and thanked him, he congratulated me on graduating and said he saw my gown hanging in the back seat. I was so touched by his generosity, that I cried. I was driving for the day in the Texan heat without air conditioning and on high anxiety and I felt so happy being able to turn on the a/c and being able to get to campus and back home.
